method: Performed a whole-lesson review of trust/UI claims, every published JSON example against the schema, provider subset compatibility, progress helper boundaries, historical evidence, metadata and accessibility wording. Re-ran the prior review verifier (20/20) and a new W6 verifier (12/12), using Ajv 2020 and local Python only. Checked current Anthropic Structured Outputs, JSON Schema 2020-12 and WAI-ARIA range guidance. Rendered light/dark full-page screenshots at 1300px; article width 792px, scroll width 1300px, Mermaid rendered. The only console error was favicon 404. No provider calls or user study were performed.
limitations: Historical user trust, model quality/cost, and prior prompt outcomes remain unverified; no user study or live provider run was performed.
Ajv validates the local schema example but does not exercise Claude Structured Outputs or another provider endpoint.
Progress helper tests cover synthetic invalid inputs and do not establish usability or assistive-technology behavior.
Trace privacy, identity and object authorization remain architecture requirements; no production authorization was tested.
The lesson remains in-review for historical claims and production/user validation.
